items_flat.title_en: US judge vacates Pentagon supply-chain risk label on Anthropic
items_flat.title_zh: 美法官撤銷五角大廈對 Anthropic 的供應鏈風險標籤
items_flat.summary_en: US District Judge Rita Lin in San Francisco granted Anthropic summary judgment, vacating Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s February designation of the company as a national-security supply-chain risk and barring named agencies from enforcing the related federal-use ban. Lin wrote the measures were “illegal and baseless,” found First Amendment retaliation and Fifth Amendment process failures, and said the Pentagon remains free not to buy Claude. Anthropic said it welcomed the ruling; the government may appeal, and a related case continues in Washington, D.C.
items_flat.summary_zh: 舊金山聯邦法官 Rita Lin 裁定 Anthropic 勝訴，撤銷國防部長 Pete Hegseth 今年 2 月將該公司列為國家安全供應鏈風險的決定，並禁止相關機關執行聯邦停用令。法官寫道相關措施「違法且毫無根據」，構成第一修正案報復與第五修正案程序瑕疵，同時強調軍方仍可自行選擇不採購 Claude。Anthropic 歡迎判決；政府可能上訴，華府另案仍進行中。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the day’s highest-stakes lab story: it removes an unprecedented US-firm blacklist but does not force the Pentagon onto Claude. What changes next is whether an appeal stays the order and whether other agencies resume contracting.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是當日最高風險的實驗室新聞：前所未有的美國公司黑名單被撤，但不代表五角大廈必須改用 Claude。下一步要看上訴是否暫停效力，以及其他機關會否恢復採購。
items_flat.quote: The empty invocation of national security is not a blank check to punish and retaliate against government critics.
items_flat.quote_zh: 空泛援引國家安全，並非懲罰與報復政府批評者的空白支票。

items_flat.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with longer scene extension and 4K upscaling
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash：場景延長與 4K 放大
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developer video generation and editing via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The update extends scenes using up to 10 seconds of prior context (versus 1 second previously), in 10-second increments up to 40 seconds total, and adds first/last-frame interpolation, 360p drafts, upscaling to 1080p or 4K, and up to three seconds of video reference. It is rolling out in AI Studio, Flow, the Gemini app for paid tiers, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出面向開發者的 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 影片生成與剪輯模型，可經 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 使用。更新能依最多 10 秒前段脈絡延長場景（先前約 1 秒），以 10 秒為單位累計至 40 秒，並新增首尾幀插值、360p 草稿、放大至 1080p 或 4K，以及最多 3 秒影片參考。正於 AI Studio、Flow、付費版 Gemini App 與企業 Agent 平台推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a controllability upgrade more than a new flagship: longer temporal memory and keyframe control matter for production workflows, but clip length remains short and quality claims still need independent comparison with Veo and rival video models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這比較像可控性升級，而非全新旗艦：更長時間記憶與關鍵幀控制對製作流程有意義，但片段仍短，畫質主張仍須與 Veo 及其他對手獨立比對。
items_flat.quote: With Omni 1.1, the model can now analyze up to 10 seconds of prior context — a leap from previous models that only referenced the final second.
items_flat.quote_zh: Omni 1.1 現可分析最多 10 秒的先前脈絡——先前模型通常只參考最後一秒。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind pilots double-blind evaluations for a proprietary Gemini model
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 試行專有 Gemini 模型的雙盲評測
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind said it is piloting what it calls the first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class model, using Google Cloud Confidential Space so evaluators cannot see Gemini weights and Google cannot see test prompts. Partners named include the Singapore AI Safety Institute, OpenMined, AVERI, and MLCommons, testing a Gemini Flash Lite model against confidential benchmarks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 表示正在試行其所稱首個針對專有前沿級模型的雙盲評測，透過 Google Cloud Confidential Space，讓評測方看不到 Gemini 權重、Google 也看不到測試提示。合作方包括新加坡 AI 安全研究所、OpenMined、AVERI 與 MLCommons，測試對象為 Gemini Flash Lite。
items_flat.analysis_en: The method targets a real integrity problem—benchmark contamination—but this is a pilot on Flash Lite, not a flagship, and independent reproducibility outside Google Cloud’s confidential stack remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 方法針對基準污染這個真實問題，但試點模型是 Flash Lite 而非旗艦，且在 Google Cloud 機密運算堆疊之外能否獨立重現仍未證實。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the world’s first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary, frontier class AI model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出全球首個針對專有前沿級 AI 模型的雙盲評測。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and 100+ firms call for a cyber-defense surge
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 與百餘家企業呼籲強化網路防禦
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted that it and organizations including Anthropic, AWS, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle are calling for a global effort to give defenders tools and support before AI-enabled attacks become more widespread. Press reporting said more than 100 firms signed, including CrowdStrike, Okta, Fortinet, Visa and Mastercard, warning that hospitals, water plants and internet infrastructure are at risk within months.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發文表示，與 Anthropic、AWS、Google、Microsoft、Oracle 等機構共同呼籲全球協力，在 AI 驅動攻擊擴大前為防禦方提供工具與支援。媒體報導逾百家企業連署，包括 CrowdStrike、Okta、Fortinet、Visa 與 Mastercard，警告醫院、水廠與網路基礎設施數月內風險升高。
items_flat.analysis_en: The letter is coordinated industry messaging after a summer of agent-related security incidents, not a new product or binding policy. What changes depends on whether labs actually share frontier defensive models and funding with critical infrastructure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是今夏一連串代理人資安事件後的產業聯合表態，不是新產品或具約束力的政策。真正改變取決於實驗室是否真把前沿防禦模型與資金交給關鍵基礎設施。
items_flat.quote: We have a limited window to strengthen cyber defenses, and together with organizations including @AnthropicAI, @awscloud, @Google, @Microsoft, and @Oracle, we're calling for a global effort to give defenders the tools, resources, and support to protect the infrastructure we all depend on.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們強化網路防禦的窗口有限；我們與 Anthropic、AWS、Google、Microsoft、Oracle 等機構共同呼籲全球協力，為防禦方提供保護共同基礎設施所需的工具、資源與支援。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic previews Model Hardware Standard for agents on lab equipment
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 預覽 Model Hardware Standard，讓代理人操作實驗室設備
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to operate physical devices such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms. It said MHS is model-agnostic, works with any programmable interface via MCP and other protocols, began with HHMI Janelia, and is being shared with partners before an open-source release. Early examples cited include Genentech assays and QuEra laser lock improving to 99.3% recovery.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，讓 AI 代理人操作顯微鏡、液體處理器與機械臂等實體設備。公司稱標準與模型無關，只要裝置有可程式介面即可經 MCP 等協定存取；起源於與 HHMI Janelia 的合作，將先與夥伴共建安全評測再開源。早期案例包括 Genentech 實驗與 QuEra 雷射鎖定恢復率提升至 99.3%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The announcement is a protocol preview, not a demonstration that Claude can already run unsupervised wet labs. Safety evaluations and partner uptake will decide whether this becomes infrastructure or a one-lab demo.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是協定預覽，並非證明 Claude 已能無人監督地操作濕實驗室。安全評測與夥伴採用，才會決定它成為基礎設施還是單一實驗室展示。
items_flat.quote: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們向第一批科研實驗室與先進製造商開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理人安全操作實體裝置的共享規格。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens 10,000 discounted Claude seats for scientists
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 為科學家開放 1 萬個優惠 Claude 席次
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said it is opening 10,000 seats for principal investigators at academic or nonprofit labs to get Claude team-plan access for one year: standard seats free, premium seats with 5x usage limits at $15 a month. It is also widening AI for Science credits beyond biology, while keeping biology and chemistry on Opus-class models and continuing to block Fable models on professional biology queries.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布為學術或非營利實驗室主持人開放 1 萬個席次，提供一年 Claude 團隊方案：標準席免費，5 倍用量進階席每月 15 美元。同時把 AI for Science 點數擴大到生物學以外領域；生化學者仍限 Opus 級模型，Fable 對專業生物學查詢持續封鎖。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is distribution and community-building, not a new model. Dual-use limits on biology remain the binding constraint for the highest-stakes lab work.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與社群經營，不是新模型。生物學雙用途限制，仍是高風險實驗工作的硬約束。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, we are announcing a significant expansion of these efforts. We are opening 10,000 seats for scientists around the world to access Claude subscriptions for free and at discounted rates for one year.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起我們大幅擴大相關計畫，為全球科學家開放 1 萬個席次，提供一年免費或優惠的 Claude 訂閱。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Ads on Free and Go tiers in India
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在印度對 Free 與 Go 方案推出 ChatGPT 廣告
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said ChatGPT Ads are rolling out in India to logged-in adults on Free and Go plans, with ads labelled and placed below responses; Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Education, and under-18 accounts stay ad-free. It named WPP and Omnicom as first agency partners, said more than 50 brands are launching, and plans self-serve Ads Manager from September 4 with daily budgets from ₹725.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT 廣告在印度向已登入的 Free 與 Go 成年用戶推出，廣告標示並置於回覆下方；Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise、Education 與未滿 18 歲帳號維持無廣告。首批代理為 WPP 與 Omnicom，逾 50 個品牌上路，並計畫 9 月 4 日開放自助 Ads Manager，每日預算起跳 725 盧比。
items_flat.analysis_en: India is a scale monetization test after earlier ads experiments elsewhere. Trust hinges on whether sponsored placements stay visually separate from answers as promised.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 印度是先前其他市場廣告試驗後的規模變現測試。信任取決於贊助版位是否真如承諾與答案視覺分離。
items_flat.quote: With ChatGPT Ads, businesses of every size can introduce themselves at relevant, high-context moments when decisions are beginning to take shape.
items_flat.quote_zh: 透過 ChatGPT Ads，各種規模的企業都能在決策成形的高語境時刻介紹自己。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches commercial operations in Brazil
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在巴西啟動商業營運
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced commercial operations based in São Paulo, saying Brazil is one of ChatGPT’s three largest markets by weekly active users, with about 215 million messages a day and nearly doubled users over the past year. It said Brazil ranks second globally by OpenAI API developers, is Codex’s largest Latin American market, and has seen ChatGPT Enterprise seats grow fivefold year over year.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布在聖保羅設立商業營運，稱巴西是 ChatGPT 週活躍用戶前三大市場之一，每日約 2.15 億則訊息，過去一年用戶近乎翻倍。公司並稱巴西 API 開發者數全球第二、是 Codex 在拉美最大市場，ChatGPT Enterprise 席次年增五倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is market-buildout, not a model launch: OpenAI is converting already-high consumer usage into a local sales, education, and public-sector footprint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是市場落地，不是模型發表：OpenAI 要把既有高用量轉成在地銷售、教育與公部門據點。
items_flat.quote: Brazil is one of ChatGPT’s three largest markets by weekly active users. The number of users in the country has nearly doubled over the past year, and people in Brazil now send approximately 215 million messages to ChatGPT each day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 以週活躍用戶計，巴西是 ChatGPT 三大市場之一。過去一年用戶數近乎翻倍，目前每天約送出 2.15 億則訊息。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI study: ChatGPT plus critical-thinking training changes student work differently
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 研究：ChatGPT 加上批判思考訓練對學生作業影響不同
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a company study reporting that ChatGPT access improved the quality and coherence of students’ answers on a five-point rubric by almost a full point, while a causal-reasoning exercise led students to generate a wider range of original ideas. More than 1,000 Bocconi first-year students worked a merchandise-store marketing case in four randomly assigned groups: GPT-4o, training, both, or neither.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發表公司研究，稱使用 ChatGPT 讓學生在五分量表上的答案品質與連貫性提升近一分；因果推理練習則讓學生產出更廣的原創構想。博科尼大學逾千名大一學生以商品店行銷個案分為四組：只用 GPT-4o、只受訓、兩者皆有、兩者皆無。
items_flat.analysis_en: The finding is useful as a product-education narrative, but it is an OpenAI-authored study, so independence and generalizability are limited until methods, sample, and task design are replicated outside the company.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果適合作為產品教育敘事，但研究由 OpenAI 自行撰寫，在方法、樣本與任務設計被外部重現前，獨立性與外推性都有限。
items_flat.quote: Access to ChatGPT improved the quality and coherence of students’ work, while an exercise in causal reasoning—a form of critical thinking—led students to generate more unique ideas.
items_flat.quote_zh: 使用 ChatGPT 提升了學生作業的品質與連貫性；因果推理這類批判思考練習則讓學生產出更多獨特構想。

items_flat.title_en: Google and Khan Academy ship Gemini-built classroom tools for the new school year
items_flat.title_zh: Google 與可汗學院推出 Gemini 打造的開學教室工具
items_flat.summary_en: Google said new Khanmigo features built with Gemini are launching for the school year: interactive diagrams that walk students through math and science concepts, and a teacher-controlled practice tool. Teachers can have Gemini draft practice questions from uploaded materials, then review, edit, or reject items before students see them.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 表示以 Gemini 打造的新 Khanmigo 功能於新學年推出：可用互動圖表引導學生理解數理概念，以及由教師控管的練習工具。教師可讓 Gemini 依上傳教材草擬練習題，再審核、修改或剔除後才發給學生。
items_flat.analysis_en: The product change is teacher-gated practice plus visual tutoring, not an unconstrained student chatbot. Impact depends on classroom uptake and whether teacher review actually prevents low-quality or leaked answers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 產品變化是教師把關的練習加上視覺輔導，不是放任的學生聊天機器人。成效取決於教室採用率，以及教師審核能否真正擋下低品質或洩題內容。
items_flat.quote: The latest version now enables teachers to partner with Gemini to plan, draft, and validate practice questions before students see them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 最新版本讓教師能與 Gemini 合作規劃、草擬並驗證練習題，學生才會看到。

openai.quote: Access to ChatGPT improved the quality and coherence of students’ work, while an exercise in causal reasoning—a form of critical thinking—led students to generate more unique ideas.
openai.quote_zh: 使用 ChatGPT 提升了學生作業的品質與連貫性；因果推理這類批判思考練習則讓學生產出更多獨特構想。

anthropic.title_en: US judge vacates Pentagon supply-chain risk label on Anthropic
anthropic.title_zh: 美法官撤銷五角大廈對 Anthropic 的供應鏈風險標籤
anthropic.summary_en: US District Judge Rita Lin in San Francisco granted Anthropic summary judgment, vacating Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s February designation of the company as a national-security supply-chain risk and barring named agencies from enforcing the related federal-use ban. Lin wrote the measures were “illegal and baseless,” found First Amendment retaliation and Fifth Amendment process failures, and said the Pentagon remains free not to buy Claude. Anthropic said it welcomed the ruling; the government may appeal, and a related case continues in Washington, D.C.
anthropic.summary_zh: 舊金山聯邦法官 Rita Lin 裁定 Anthropic 勝訴，撤銷國防部長 Pete Hegseth 今年 2 月將該公司列為國家安全供應鏈風險的決定，並禁止相關機關執行聯邦停用令。法官寫道相關措施「違法且毫無根據」，構成第一修正案報復與第五修正案程序瑕疵，同時強調軍方仍可自行選擇不採購 Claude。Anthropic 歡迎判決；政府可能上訴，華府另案仍進行中。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the day’s highest-stakes lab story: it removes an unprecedented US-firm blacklist but does not force the Pentagon onto Claude. What changes next is whether an appeal stays the order and whether other agencies resume contracting.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是當日最高風險的實驗室新聞：前所未有的美國公司黑名單被撤，但不代表五角大廈必須改用 Claude。下一步要看上訴是否暫停效力，以及其他機關會否恢復採購。
anthropic.quote: The empty invocation of national security is not a blank check to punish and retaliate against government critics.
anthropic.quote_zh: 空泛援引國家安全，並非懲罰與報復政府批評者的空白支票。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic previews Model Hardware Standard for agents on lab equipment
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 預覽 Model Hardware Standard，讓代理人操作實驗室設備
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to operate physical devices such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms. It said MHS is model-agnostic, works with any programmable interface via MCP and other protocols, began with HHMI Janelia, and is being shared with partners before an open-source release. Early examples cited include Genentech assays and QuEra laser lock improving to 99.3% recovery.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，讓 AI 代理人操作顯微鏡、液體處理器與機械臂等實體設備。公司稱標準與模型無關，只要裝置有可程式介面即可經 MCP 等協定存取；起源於與 HHMI Janelia 的合作，將先與夥伴共建安全評測再開源。早期案例包括 Genentech 實驗與 QuEra 雷射鎖定恢復率提升至 99.3%。
anthropic.analysis_en: The announcement is a protocol preview, not a demonstration that Claude can already run unsupervised wet labs. Safety evaluations and partner uptake will decide whether this becomes infrastructure or a one-lab demo.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是協定預覽，並非證明 Claude 已能無人監督地操作濕實驗室。安全評測與夥伴採用，才會決定它成為基礎設施還是單一實驗室展示。
anthropic.quote: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們向第一批科研實驗室與先進製造商開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理人安全操作實體裝置的共享規格。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens 10,000 discounted Claude seats for scientists
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 為科學家開放 1 萬個優惠 Claude 席次
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic said it is opening 10,000 seats for principal investigators at academic or nonprofit labs to get Claude team-plan access for one year: standard seats free, premium seats with 5x usage limits at $15 a month. It is also widening AI for Science credits beyond biology, while keeping biology and chemistry on Opus-class models and continuing to block Fable models on professional biology queries.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布為學術或非營利實驗室主持人開放 1 萬個席次，提供一年 Claude 團隊方案：標準席免費，5 倍用量進階席每月 15 美元。同時把 AI for Science 點數擴大到生物學以外領域；生化學者仍限 Opus 級模型，Fable 對專業生物學查詢持續封鎖。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is distribution and community-building, not a new model. Dual-use limits on biology remain the binding constraint for the highest-stakes lab work.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是通路與社群經營，不是新模型。生物學雙用途限制，仍是高風險實驗工作的硬約束。
anthropic.quote: Starting today, we are announcing a significant expansion of these efforts. We are opening 10,000 seats for scientists around the world to access Claude subscriptions for free and at discounted rates for one year.
anthropic.quote_zh: 即日起我們大幅擴大相關計畫，為全球科學家開放 1 萬個席次，提供一年免費或優惠的 Claude 訂閱。

google.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with longer scene extension and 4K upscaling
google.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash：場景延長與 4K 放大
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developer video generation and editing via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The update extends scenes using up to 10 seconds of prior context (versus 1 second previously), in 10-second increments up to 40 seconds total, and adds first/last-frame interpolation, 360p drafts, upscaling to 1080p or 4K, and up to three seconds of video reference. It is rolling out in AI Studio, Flow, the Gemini app for paid tiers, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出面向開發者的 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 影片生成與剪輯模型，可經 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 使用。更新能依最多 10 秒前段脈絡延長場景（先前約 1 秒），以 10 秒為單位累計至 40 秒，並新增首尾幀插值、360p 草稿、放大至 1080p 或 4K，以及最多 3 秒影片參考。正於 AI Studio、Flow、付費版 Gemini App 與企業 Agent 平台推出。
google.analysis_en: This is a controllability upgrade more than a new flagship: longer temporal memory and keyframe control matter for production workflows, but clip length remains short and quality claims still need independent comparison with Veo and rival video models.
google.analysis_zh: 這比較像可控性升級，而非全新旗艦：更長時間記憶與關鍵幀控制對製作流程有意義，但片段仍短，畫質主張仍須與 Veo 及其他對手獨立比對。
google.quote: With Omni 1.1, the model can now analyze up to 10 seconds of prior context — a leap from previous models that only referenced the final second.
google.quote_zh: Omni 1.1 現可分析最多 10 秒的先前脈絡——先前模型通常只參考最後一秒。

google.title_en: DeepMind pilots double-blind evaluations for a proprietary Gemini model
google.title_zh: DeepMind 試行專有 Gemini 模型的雙盲評測
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind said it is piloting what it calls the first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class model, using Google Cloud Confidential Space so evaluators cannot see Gemini weights and Google cannot see test prompts. Partners named include the Singapore AI Safety Institute, OpenMined, AVERI, and MLCommons, testing a Gemini Flash Lite model against confidential benchmarks.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 表示正在試行其所稱首個針對專有前沿級模型的雙盲評測，透過 Google Cloud Confidential Space，讓評測方看不到 Gemini 權重、Google 也看不到測試提示。合作方包括新加坡 AI 安全研究所、OpenMined、AVERI 與 MLCommons，測試對象為 Gemini Flash Lite。
google.analysis_en: The method targets a real integrity problem—benchmark contamination—but this is a pilot on Flash Lite, not a flagship, and independent reproducibility outside Google Cloud’s confidential stack remains unproven.
google.analysis_zh: 方法針對基準污染這個真實問題，但試點模型是 Flash Lite 而非旗艦，且在 Google Cloud 機密運算堆疊之外能否獨立重現仍未證實。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing the world’s first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary, frontier class AI model.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出全球首個針對專有前沿級 AI 模型的雙盲評測。

google.title_en: Google and Khan Academy ship Gemini-built classroom tools for the new school year
google.title_zh: Google 與可汗學院推出 Gemini 打造的開學教室工具
google.summary_en: Google said new Khanmigo features built with Gemini are launching for the school year: interactive diagrams that walk students through math and science concepts, and a teacher-controlled practice tool. Teachers can have Gemini draft practice questions from uploaded materials, then review, edit, or reject items before students see them.
google.summary_zh: Google 表示以 Gemini 打造的新 Khanmigo 功能於新學年推出：可用互動圖表引導學生理解數理概念，以及由教師控管的練習工具。教師可讓 Gemini 依上傳教材草擬練習題，再審核、修改或剔除後才發給學生。
google.analysis_en: The product change is teacher-gated practice plus visual tutoring, not an unconstrained student chatbot. Impact depends on classroom uptake and whether teacher review actually prevents low-quality or leaked answers.
google.analysis_zh: 產品變化是教師把關的練習加上視覺輔導，不是放任的學生聊天機器人。成效取決於教室採用率，以及教師審核能否真正擋下低品質或洩題內容。
google.quote: The latest version now enables teachers to partner with Gemini to plan, draft, and validate practice questions before students see them.
google.quote_zh: 最新版本讓教師能與 Gemini 合作規劃、草擬並驗證練習題，學生才會看到。

brief_en: A US judge struck down the Pentagon’s Anthropic supply-chain blacklist. Google shipped Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video controls. OpenAI, Anthropic and 100+ firms urged a cyber-defense surge. Anthropic previewed lab-hardware agents and scientist seats; OpenAI pushed India ads and Brazil sales.
brief_zh: 美法官撤銷五角大廈對 Anthropic 的供應鏈黑名單。Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 影片控制。OpenAI、Anthropic 等百餘家呼籲強化網路防禦。Anthropic 預覽實驗室硬體標準並開放科學家席次；OpenAI 在印度推廣告、在巴西開商業營運。
